documents.title: AWS Lambda quotas
documents.summary: AWS Lambda has documented quotas and configurable limits. Timeout-related claims should be checked against the Lambda configuration and quota documentation.

documents.title: Configure Lambda function timeout
documents.summary: Lambda timeout is configurable and can be set up to 15 minutes. Claims that Lambda can only run for 5 minutes conflict with the official timeout limit.

documents.title: Hosting a static website using Amazon S3
documents.summary: Amazon S3 can host a static website from a bucket when static website hosting is configured.

documents.title: What is Amazon S3?
documents.summary: Amazon S3 is an object storage service. It stores data as objects within buckets.

documents.title: Knowledge bases for Amazon Bedrock
documents.summary: Knowledge Bases for Amazon Bedrock support retrieval augmented generation by connecting foundation models to data sources for relevant retrieval.

documents.title: Guardrails for Amazon Bedrock
documents.summary: Guardrails help implement safeguards for generative AI applications. They reduce risk but should not be described as a 100% guarantee that every wrong answer is blocked.

documents.title: What is Amazon DynamoDB?
documents.summary: Amazon DynamoDB is a serverless NoSQL database service suitable for key-value and document data, including analysis metadata and result records.

documents.title: What is Amazon API Gateway?
documents.summary: Amazon API Gateway helps create, publish, maintain, monitor, and secure APIs at scale for backend services such as Lambda.
